text: On geddo hino nana Aayeeje Allah ɗen ka Alqur'aana hino janngee e dow makko, refti o duumoo e geddi e keeferaaku makko, o townitanoo jokkugol goonga kan, wa si tawii o nanaano ɗen Aayeeje janngaaɗe e dow makko. Awa an Nulaaɗo, humpitu on bone makko laakara, ɗum le ko lepte muusuɗe hino habbitii mo ton.
